prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create a premium 3D advertising artwork asset for Sorted, a UK money-planning app. This is a dramatic tangible product campaign, not a screenshot gallery. Square 1:1 composition, no typography and no interface drawn.
Scene: sculptural everyday-life objects breaking out around a single smartphone, on an opaque pale blue-slate studio cyclorama (#f0f2f7). Render like a superb tactile product campaign: polished aluminium edges, finely textured satin ceramic, soft natural directional shadows, convincing ambient occlusion. Calm, confident, playful grown-up aesthetic.
Composition must allow exact app-screen compositing: one large upright front-facing silver smartphone, completely straight with parallel vertical sides, not tilted, screen facing directly at camera. The whole device occupies approximately x=31% to 69%, y=9% to 91%. Screen is blank solid pale blue-slate #f0f2f7, clean and uninterrupted, rounded corners, slim dark bezel, tiny black camera pill near top. Do not put any object over the interior of the screen. Device has real depth with visible aluminium lower and right edges.
Around the phone: an oversized sculpted teal reusable grocery bag floating on the right, an orange ceramic takeaway coffee cup and lid floating at lower left, a pale sculpted calendar tile with small indigo tabs and NO markings at upper left, a folded white receipt curling away at lower right with NO writing, all arranged in a purposeful circular outward burst emerging from behind the phone. Objects are three-dimensional with varied scale and physical thickness, not flat icons, no square app tiles. Keep the perimeter objects within canvas, use convincing different focal depths. Avoid clutter: four objects only, hero phone dominates.
Palette: slate white, indigo #4f46e5 for subtle object details, grocery teal #34d399, coffee orange #fb923c. No red, no neon, no money raining, no coins, no charts, no fake logos. No words, letters, numbers, labels, buttons or watermarks anywhere. Leave a little breathing room around the scene. Photorealistic stylised 3D studio render, high material quality, an editorial advertising image rather than generic SaaS art.
note: No generated UI or figures. The campaign composites real production components in the browser.
